metadata.description: Scheduled analytics rules over the platform's DeviceSecurity_CL table in Microsoft Sentinel.
Log Analytics workspace with Microsoft Sentinel and the DeviceSecurity_CL table (same resource group).

properties.displayName: Critical vulnerability on a quarantined device
properties.description: An open critical (CVSS 9.0+) vulnerability finding exists on a device whose zero trust status is Quarantined. Fires when the finding or the device state was reported in the last hour. Matches the default status name "Quarantined"; edit the query if the tenant renamed it.
properties.query:
let recent = 1h;
let lookback = 14d;
let quarantined = DeviceSecurity_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback) and isnotempty(DeviceUid)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, DeviceGroups, DeviceHostname, DeviceIp) by SourceTenant, DeviceUid
    | where tostring(DeviceGroups) has "Quarantined"
    | project DeviceSeen = TimeGenerated, SourceTenant, DeviceUid, DeviceHostname, DeviceIp;
DeviceSecurity_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback) and ClassUid == 2002
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Status, SeverityId, CveId, CvssScore, IsExploitAvailable) by SourceTenant, FindingUid, DeviceUid
| where Status !in ("Resolved", "Suppressed") and SeverityId == 5
| join kind=inner quarantined on SourceTenant, DeviceUid
| where TimeGenerated > ago(recent) or DeviceSeen > ago(recent)
| project TimeGenerated, SourceTenant, DeviceUid, DeviceHostname, DeviceIp, CveId, CvssScore, IsExploitAvailable, FindingUid

properties.displayName: New device with a known exploited vulnerability
properties.description: A device first seen in the last 24 hours has an open vulnerability listed in the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalogue.
properties.query:
DeviceSecurity_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) and ClassUid == 2002
| where IsExploitAvailable == true and Status !in ("Resolved", "Suppressed")
| where DeviceFirstSeen > ago(1d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, DeviceHostname, DeviceIp, DeviceFirstSeen, CvssScore, SeverityId, FindingUid) by SourceTenant, DeviceUid, CveId
| project TimeGenerated, SourceTenant, DeviceUid, DeviceHostname, DeviceIp, DeviceFirstSeen, CveId, CvssScore, FindingUid
